resolved.title: LLaMA: Open and Efficient Foundation Language Models
resolved.abstract: We introduce LLaMA, a collection of foundation language models ranging from 7B to 65B parameters. We train our models on trillions of tokens, and show that it is possible to train state-of-the-art models using publicly available datasets exclusively, without resorting to proprietary and inaccessible datasets. resolved.title: Learning Transferable Visual Models From Natural Language Supervision
resolved.abstract: State-of-the-art computer vision systems are trained to predict a fixed set of predetermined object categories.
